selection_rule.description: Within each measured layer and recovery construction, retain only experts whose endpoint reduced mean forward KLD in both predeclared eight-document groups. Keep the single retained expert with the largest sixteen-document mean reduction when a same-layer composition regresses either group.
selection_rule.document_role: candidate selection; these documents cannot qualify the registered composition

evidence_boundary: The registration freezes a three-layer candidate before its combined model-KLD measurement. The selected endpoints are dense experiment representations. The rank-four correction charges 65,536 logical BF16 factor bytes, but the complete GLM QSRT storage format and checkpoint byte ledger remain unimplemented.
